title: Assembling adic path transport with scalar compatibility
statement: For an IntegralFibrePathTransport over l,Y,Q, there exists an AdicFibrePathTransport whose integral family is the supplied one. Its rational and algebraic paths and its integral and rational scalar comparisons satisfy all seven exact normalization and compatibility predicates of [new-e5-fibre-path-transport-data]. Definitions and hypotheses are those of [new-e5-fibre-path-transport-data], [new-e5-integral-fibre-path-construction].

source.place: Weil II (1.1.1) b)-d), pp.146-147; explicit part of the fibre transport argument

proof.text: Keep the integral family. Use the rationalized family and the descended algebraic family. Use the canonical integral and rational scalar isomorphisms. Fill the seven record fields with their proved evaluation, germ, tensor and scalar-path theorems; the integral field equality is reflexive.

lean.statement:
theorem adic_fibre_path_transport_of_integral {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] [IsNoetherian Y] [Y.IsSeparated]
    [∀ x : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField x)]
    (Q : Type (u + 1)) [Field Q] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Q] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Q]
    (i : IntegralFibrePathTransport l Y Q) :
    ∃ a : AdicFibrePathTransport l Y Q, a.integral = i.linear
